1.o: On the live talk show Astraea no Tenbin, the topic of the day is the existence of vampires after a series of attacks that have left distinctive bite marks on the victims.

2.o: Kaburagi Akira is a seemingly normal high school student at the time that Mina Tepes creates the Vampire Bund.

3.o: The day after saving Mina, Akira wakes up in bed with her and has regained some of his memories.

4.o: With the establishment of the Vampire Bund, Mina Tepes is ready to hold a press conference, so many members of the press have come to the island.

5.o: It becomes known, by some students, that Nanami was attacked by vampires. Akira and Yuki are attacked by vampires wearing the same school uniform as them, and they are saved at the last moment by Meiren who takes on the band of vampires with ease. Mina sends Nella to kidnap the grandson of the Prime Minister when he refuses to accept Mina's plan.

6.o: Akira is confronted by Meiren, and Akira begins doubting Mina. He finds out about Mina kidnapping the Prime Minister's grandson and confronts her about it and about the fact that vampires have infiltrated the school. She says that the vampire society rests on her shoulders and that she will do whatever necessary to make sure that the Vampire Bund plan is fulfilled. After hearing this, Akira teams up with some of the kids from school to eradicate the vampires inside the school.

7.o: Despite their differences, Mina and Akira must learn to work together in order to save some student council members from the rogue vampires who've taken them hostage.

8.o: On the surface, things appear to have calmed down at the academy, but among the students there are deep physical and psychological scars that have not yet healed.

9.o: Akira's curiosity about the concept of eternity leads him to ask Mina questions that are difficult to answer. Though it may sound promising, eternity is not without its harsh realities.

10.o: The Bund is finally enjoying some well-earned peace when chaos visits once more - the Three Clans have appeared in the Bund, putting Akira's life in grave peril.

11.o: Killers-for-hire stalk Akira, and the werewolf's inability to transform puts his life in jeopardy. Meanwhile, Mina raises the stakes of her wager after a particularly unpleasant test of her purity.

12.o: Two beastly warriors shed blood in defense of identical princesses, and Mina learns the shocking secret behind the legacy of the true bloods! Mina then made a pledge to Akria to stay with him forever like Akria did as a young boy.

1.o: Racing team Black Shadow led by the demon king Ahab. The Saionji Racing Team stands up against the villains who will do whatever it takes to win. Ken controls the Hayabusa and defeats Black Shadow's Jack the Ripper. Enraged by the unexpected outcome, Ahab invites Sword to a race across Australia and sets a dastardly trap for him.

2.o: The demon king Ahab, angry at Jack the Ripper's defeat, sends Romy, a female racer, to Japan as a new challenger in order to crush the Saionji racing team. Without the doctor's permission, Tsurugi agrees to participate in a hill climb race that he has no experience with. After repeated training, the entire team participates in the battle, but they fall into Ahab's trap and find themselves in a predicament.

3.o: The Saionji team participated in a race sponsored by the Le Mans Kingdom. The battlefield will be the Great Limestone Cave Circuit, where once you get lost you will never be able to leave. However, Jack the Ripper steals the king's course blueprints and sabotages the swords. Swords was once on the verge of giving up, but in order to repay the friendship of his friends, he aims for victory!

4.t: Mystery of the Demon King Ahab
4.o: Under orders from Hayabusa to defeat him, Baron welcomes Hurricane Harry, who had been banished from the racing world, to become a member of Black Shadow. A sword duel with Harry begins on a large ice field at -50 degrees Celsius. Harry aims his sword with a special move. Meanwhile, Homer, who lost the fight with Harry and was fired, plots to kill Ahab and take over Black Shadow.

5.o: An invitation to the Agnaria race has arrived from the demon king Ahab. It's a dangerous, life-threatening race through a remodeled ghost town filled with unmanned work vehicles and dynamite. What's more, many of the traps are operated by monkeys, not humans. Still, Tsurugi decides to participate. Join Yamato in a deadly race filled with intrigue!

6.o: Thomson, known as the god of racing, was killed by Black Impulse, who drives his opponents to death through team play. When Tsurugi learns that Thomson was the one who taught his brother how to race, he decides to take revenge. Meanwhile, the cunning Baron has prepared another set of Black Impulse as his trump card. Team play has no choice but to fight with team play!

7.o: Kamikaze and Gantetsu attempt a race, but not only do they run out of fuel, but their temporary gas station is blown up, leaving them stranded. Baron issues a ruthless order to kill him, but Hawk is unable to lay his hands on the sword that believed in his innocence.

8.o: Sakura, who is obsessed with designing a special machine, stays up all night to complete the new machine, Sakura. As soon as the race at Dead Valley began, it was my turn. Since it was difficult to access the steep mountain course at Big Garry and all the important spots had been captured, the Sakura was assigned a major role in refueling.

9.o: The Saionji Racing Team, which is on a winning streak, has received an invitation to an oil race in Africa. Since the journey will be tough, crossing deserts and snowy mountains just below the equator, the doctor will conduct an endurance test using a kamikaze machine. Shocked to see his beloved car damaged and broken, Kamikaze returns to his parents' home, but is chased away by his mother who understands the situation. When he returned to the research institute, he was greeted by...

10.o: Black Shadow realized that the Hayabusa's weakness was its ability to climb hills, and created a demonic labyrinth course using the underground ruins of Tolteca. The race begins, and the swords that have undergone special training fly smoothly through the vast ruins. However, Baron uses the stone statue that is the keystone of the labyrinth to break down the structure of the ruins, leaving the course suspended in the air due to a large amount of sand!

11.o: Angered by the news of his retirement, Tsurugi takes out his frustration at the constant tests on the doctor. The doctor was developing a new V3 engine to overcome Hayabusa's weaknesses. Although the prototype was completed, the experiment failed. Tsurugi, who will be participating in a race in the Himalayas, decides to install a V3 engine on the condition that the engine speed does not increase.

12.t: Dragon of the Shooting Star of Destiny Rival
12.o: In order to defeat Hayabusa, the Demon King Ahab scouted the lone wolf and skilled racer, the Shooting Star Dragon. Ryu rides to the test course to test the enemy's ability, and takes a liking to the sword, and a strange friendship develops between the two. But a game is a game. Seeing the pebble thrown on the water surface, Ryu comes up with a special move to overcome the Hayabusa by making up for the difference in machine performance.

13.t: Swiftly Run in the Wheel Traveling Piece
13.o: Tsurugi, who tasted defeat due to Ryu's triple jump running method, devised a single-wheel running method inspired by car chases. The stage for the rematch will be a race on the Iranian plateau. The fierce battle for the top between the dragon and the sword continues. Ken defeats Ryu in a battle over a rocky area, but is faced with a difficult situation due to the course's weaknesses in single-wheel running. If he makes a mistake, he will fall to the bottom of the valley, but he will take part in a high-stakes game!

14.t: Road Race is the Way of the Sword
14.o: A man named Will Prague sells himself to the Saionji team as a racer in search of wealth and fame. When the doctor tries to drive him back, Will points out that the reason the Gantetsu can't win is due to a problem with the driver's ability. Iwatetsu is troubled by these words, and before he knows it, he starts to lose himself. What brought him back to normal was the teachings of his father, a martial artist.

15.o: A crimson machine suddenly appeared from behind Hayabusa and overtook it in a brilliant manner. It was the legendary car, the Royal Majesty, which had gone missing. The person behind the wheel is Romy, the daughter of the late famous racer Wells. Romy, who has fought with a sword before, challenges him to a one-on-one match at Yatsugatake, hoping to settle the matter this time.

16.o: Journalist Atkin, who covered Romy's death, visits the institute. He asks for your help in discovering Ahab's true identity. Rejected by the doctor, Atkin changes his face through plastic surgery and infiltrates Black Shadow, calling himself Lightning Tony. Tony approaches the sword, reveals his true identity, and proposes a match-fixing match. The sword that is troubled by troubles...

17.t: Trial Run of the Mystery Car X1
17.o: The shooting star dragon, who was defeated by the single-wheel running method, continues to train for mountain races under Professor Mephisto. Black Shadow has completed its secret weapon against Hayabusa, the quick cornering wheel. After witnessing the murder of the man who took the blueprints with him, Ryu participates in the Innsbruck race with mixed feelings. Ken also participates and takes on a battle with his archenemy.

18.t: Listen to the V4 Engine My Friend
18.o: After experiencing defeat for the second time at the hands of the dragon, Tsurugi declines the invitation for a comfort trip and remains at the research institute. In order to settle the matter on equal terms with him, Ryu dares to give him the blueprint for a quick cornering wheel. The new V4 engine has already been completed and all that remains is testing. However, due to an unexpected problem, V4 becomes unusable.

19.o: The sword was tangled up by a biker gang, and while protecting Sakura, he sustained a wound on his precious left hand. Furthermore, he is given a restraining order as punishment and is prohibited from riding a falcon. Meanwhile, Baron was scouting the Gayla brothers. They are racers who defeat their opponents with a combination unique to twins. The sword's eyesight was taken away by the powerful ultraviolet rays...

20.o: Kamikaze, who participated in the All-Japan race, tries his best to show his mother how good he is, and ends up seriously injuring the driver without noticing trouble in the car in front of him. Kamikaze is unable to drive as he would like due to the shock, but the doctor still orders him to get on the machine. Ahab is not going to miss this opportunity and requests to participate in the race on the Great Snowy Mountain.

21.o: To put an end to the fierce battle, Ahab takes off his armor and reveals his true identity. He then challenges the Saionji Racing Team on the condition that the loser retires from the racing world. In order to defeat Ahab, the Doctor installs a V5 engine into the Hayabusa. Have everyone master the one-wheel method. And now, the battle for the future of the racing world has begun!

1.t: Garlic With Extra Vegetables / Maayu / Rich
1.o: Yū Ōsawa takes an interest in the silent transfer student, Koizumi, and ends up joining her in line for a ramen shop. Picking the same pork ramen with garlic and extra vegetables as Koizumi picked, Yū bears witness to Koizumi's love of ramen, getting to see a side of her that she does not usually show. Later, Yū goes to the school cafeteria to try its Māyu ramen, learning about the various kinds of ramen from Koizumi. On another day, Yū follows Koizumi to another restaurant where she indulges in a ramen made from a rich broth.

2.o: After just being dumped by her boyfriend, Yū's friend Misa Nakamura follows Koizumi to a ramen shop and ends up picking its spiciest dish, Hokkyoku ramen. Taking a liking to the extremely spicy ramen, Misa lets out her frustration over her breakup and becomes friends with Koizumi. Later, Yū's other friend, Jun Takahashi, is asked to speak with Koizumi about her poor test results, which turns out to be because she was exhausted following a ramen pilgrimage. Hearing about all the peculiar flavors of ramen Koizumi has tried, Jun decides to try out a Pineapple Shrimp Salt ramen at a local ramen sh

3.t: Saimin / Flavor Concentration Counter / Instant Noodles
3.o: As Yū tries to invite Koizumi to a WcDaniel's restaurant, Koizumi explains how she once had saimin noodle soup from a WcDaniel's branch in Hawaii. Later, Yū goes with Koizumi to a peculiar restaurant where customers eat in secluded cubicles and order using forms. After finding Koizumi collapsed from starvation due to her favorite restaurant being closed, Yū takes her back to her house and makes her various homemade ramen dishes, which prove to be a hit with her.

4.t: Western Restaurant / Red or White / Convenience Store
4.o: Worried over whether Koizumi has a boyfriend, Yū follows her to a Western restaurant, where she seems to meet up with a bunch of guys. To her relief, Yū discovers that Koizumi was simply waiting for an open space in a ramen stand behind the restaurant. Later, Yū goes to a ramen restaurant with Misa, each ordering red Akamaru ramen and white Karaka ramen respectively, while Koizumi goes to it moments after they leave. During the weekend, Jun comes across Koizumi at a convenience store and tries out her recommendation of instant ramen.

5.o: Koizumi enjoys her latest favorite, Tomato Ramen, while Yū provides her own commentary. Upon hearing about the beneficial algae, euglena, Jun goes with Koizumi to try some green ramen which is rich in euglena. Later, Yū stands in a huge line for a popular ramen shop with the intent of switching out with Koizumi, getting angry with someone else when he cuts his friends in. In the end, they get told off by Koizumi and all decide to go to the back of the line to show their appreciation for the ramen.

6.o: Koizumi gets up early in the morning to eat some dried sardine ramen, catching the eye of Yū's older brother, Shū, who tries the same thing. On a hot sunny day, the girls take Koizumi's cue and try various types of cold hiyashi ramen. While attending a ramen fayre at a museum, Koizumi comes across a lost German girl named Hannah, sharing some of her ramen with her before helping her reunite with her mother. As thanks, she receives a voucher for some German-style ramen.

7.o: As summer vacation begins, Yū, Misa, and Jun go to an amusement park together before touring around Asakusa in yukata. Afterwards, Yū runs into Koizumi and decides to accompany her on a "nationwide" ramen tour around the city, trying ramen from across Japan.

8.o: While Yū and Misa go to the Katase Higashi beach, Jun accompanies Koizumi to a shop that serves local variants of instant ramen from all across the country, becoming curious about what career she is aiming for. Later, Shū and his friends go to an iekei-style restaurant to try ramen with rice, becoming awed when Koizumi enters the same restaurant.

9.t: Mountain / Pork Guy / Fatty Pork Roast
9.o: Koizumi hikes up Mount Tsukuba in order to work up an appetite for its local ramen shop. Misa's younger brother Kenta tries to tackle the sizeable Buta Yarō ramen in Akihabara, he becomes motivated after seeing Koizumi easily manage the mega-sized portion. Later, Misa, believing Koizumi to have some secret behind her beauty, inadvertently ends up ordering a ramen full of back fat alongside her, leading to an addiction.

10.t: Ramen With Unknown Flavor / Running Ramen / Accepting Challenges!!
10.o: Yū becomes curious about a mysterious blue ramen that Koizumi was eating. Shū invites Yū to a conveyor belt sushi restaurant where they spot Koizumi enjoying one of its ramen dishes, prompting them to order some themselves. Later, Jun invites everyone to a Chūka restaurant in Kagurazaka to help her eat a massive gyōza her mother had reserved, with Koizumi ordering countless ramen dishes on top of it.

11.o: Yū tries to recall a tasty ramen she ate in Osaka when she was a kid, which turns out to be a dish literally called Tasty Ramen. After Yū and Koizumi go to a Tokyo branch at Kabukichō to try the dish, Koizumi goes on a ramen pilgrimage to Osaka where she encounters a woman named Ayane. Serving as Koizumi's bodyguard against guys trying to pick her up, Ayane accompanies Koizumi during her remaining ramen stops. Hearing about how Ayane is due to leave Osaka after quitting her job, Koizumi takes her to a ramen restraurant that she remembers from her childhood, but is later slightly disconcerted u

12.o: While heading home from Osaka, Yū ends up stranded in Nagoya after seemingly spotting Koizumi from afar and hopping off the train. With only 500 yen on hand, Yū goes to a fast food ramen shop, where she thankfully runs into Koizumi. Later in Autumn, Koizumi catches a cold and ends up taking several days off school, her continued absence taking its toll on Yū. After Koizumi eventually recovers, Yū decides to leave her alone to let her enjoy her first ramen in weeks.

1.o: The first round of the competition features a battle of the dragons, as a cabin built to resemble a dragon's eye faces off against a dragon's claw.

3.o: The cabins this time include a laser-cut project inspired by the legend of King Arthur, a double-decker tepee, and a luxury getaway on a sea fort.

4.o: The competition concludes as two cabins fight for a place in the final. This week an ambitious treehouse cabin takes on a tin-clad cabin with a trick up its sleeve.

16.o: Wolf meets with one of the fire's survivors. Confined to the hospital, Yankee thinks about revenge and misses his family. Valenzuela meets with Phoebe.

17.o: Cara Sucia celebrates his terrorism. Yankee proposes a radical idea to Revueltas and Botas that involves an unexpected collaboration.

18.o: Citizens protest against La Contra and violence ensues. Cara Sucia targets Del Toro's family. Yankee starts working with the authorities.

20.o: Yankee makes Ignacio a difficult offer while also attempting to help Amelia. Cara Sucia targets his rival's drones with a winged friend.

21.o: Phoebe realizes she sold guns to La Contra and Yankee decides to use it to their advantage. Del Toro sets his sights on Cara Sucia.

22.o: With the marines under suspicion, Del Toro investigates Diana de la Hoya's murder. Yvonne and Yankee make a peace deal. Wolf's trauma haunts her.

23.o: Yankee has serious concerns about his family's safety in light of his discovery. Wolf is suspicious about La Contra's actions.

24.o: In a large meeting with Mexico's narcos, Yankee suggests adding fentanyl to the drug trade and offers up a deal with Wolf.

25.o: Yankee and Phoebe decide how to handle their future, which hinges on his relationship with Amelia. Yvonne makes a power play. Billy chooses violence.

1.o: After a fight with her sister Becca, Alma gets in a car accident and sees something mysterious.

2.o: While recovering in the hospital from her car accident, Alma talks with her dead father, who has a confusing and compelling request.

3.o: Alma begins her training with her dad, and tries to get a grip on her new reality.

1.o: Cherusci tribal chief Segimer bristles at the increasing demands of new governor Varus. Secret lovers Thusnelda and Folkwin deal Rome a symbolic blow.

2.o: The theft of the standard provokes a crisis, reuniting Roman officer Ari with his father Segimer, and childhood friends Folkwin and Thusnelda.

3.o: Ari commands troops ordered by Varus to hunt down and kill Folkwin, whose family and home village are put in danger for his act of defiance.

4.o: Ari embraces his new role with the Cherusci but his shift of allegiances runs deeper than Varus knows. Thusnelda and Folkwin rally a rival tribe.

5.o: Ari and Thusnelda forge a political marriage and begin uniting the fractious Germanic tribes. Folkwin is believed dead but has actually been enslaved.

6.o: Ari leads Varus and three Roman legions into the Teutoburg Forest — and into history. Thusnelda makes a bloody sacrifice to preserve the alliance.

1.o: Ari suspects the Romans of rebuilding their forces, so he seeks the help of an eastern tribal chief, Marbod. Ari’s brother, Flavus, arrives in Germania.

2.o: A friend comes to Thusnelda’s aid when she infiltrates the Roman camp. Without Ari knowing, Marbod meets with Tiberius in a bid to secure peace.

3.o: Germanicus accuses Flavus of being a traitor. Ari brings Gaius to the village and then seeks revenge against Marbod. Thusnelda is angry at Ari for lying.

4.o: Tiberius requires a test of Marbod's loyalty. Flavus proposes an offer to Germanicus. The tribal chiefs gather to name Marbod king but tragedy strikes.

5.o: Marbod confronts Tiberius and demands justice. Thusnelda and Folkwin set out on a mission. Gaius hides out in the forest and makes a shocking discovery.

6.o: The tribes prepare to attack the Roman camp before ships with reinforcements arrive. Segestes approaches Tiberius with a treacherous proposal.

1.o: After losing her husband to serial killer Lee Soo Yeon, police detective Lee Hwa Sun makes her way to Muji city in order to bring the murderer in. But unlike what she is hoping to find, she runs into an enormous sinkhole in the middle of the mountains. Black smoke arises from this mysterious sinkhole and the people of Muji are left clueless about what it is.

2.o: The news of the sinkhole spreads throughout Muji and more people come to look. However, things go wrong as they get infected by the black smoke and start attacking each other. Not knowing how it is triggered, but a large amount of smoke ascends from the hole and slowly covers Muji city. Hwa Sun and Tae Han go separate ways for their own objectives, but they both fight their way through the chaos.

1.o: Dave Turin, a former Gold Rush miner, sets out on his own prospecting for an abandoned gold mine to reopen. But when an investor backs out, Dave has to decide if he's willing to risk his family's life savings on his ability to bring home the gold.

2.o: Dozer Dave bets his life savings that he can unearth piles of gold from an abandoned mine using salvaged equipment and a team of amateur miners.

3.o: Dave faces a nightmare scenario when the ground he's mining goes cold and no one knows why; with his season hanging in the balance, the pressure mounts for Dave to get them back on the gold.

4.o: Dave's entire season comes down to the final 24 hours and a bold risk that threatens to shut down his operation and force him out of the gold game for good.

1.o: Dave Turin and his crew kick off an epic new mining season in the historic hills of Montana. After a freak accident nearly derails their expedition from the start, they rally and find the first big gold of the season.

2.o: After a great start, Dave and his crew hit their first problem. A potential flaw with their trommel could end their season before it's even begun.

3.o: Dave gambles on a new piece of machinery. Tensions grow when gold goes missing somewhere on the mine, and Jason makes a game-changing discovery.

4.o: Dave and his crew are low on morale and behind on their target. He calls in a friend to search for gold at Birdseye while he investigates a mine below...

5.o: Dave Turin and his crew turn their trommel up to double speed hoping to get the most gold from Montana’s historic Birdseye mine; dirty water and ground that’s not producing challenge the crew, forcing Dave to call an audible at the last minute.

7.o: Chris makes an incredible discovery that sets the team up on the best gold all season. As winter starts to close in, Dave gets a hot tip that takes him 2,500 miles north to a mine where he pans the biggest nugget of his career.

8.o: In the season finale, it's a race against mother nature at the Blue Room Cut to capitalize on a short weather window before winter closes Team Turin out of Montana. Overcoming early mechanical setbacks, the team perseveres to a surprising end.

16.o: Bertie searches for the inspiration she needs to finish a song for Seaside by the Seashore's upcoming un-condemning party.

17.o: With everyone working hard to get Seaside by the Seashore looking spiffy, Arlo elects to go the extra mile and fix up the old Ferris Wheel.

18.o: Arlo and Bertie investigate the case of the missing package, not knowing that a much larger mystery is about to command their attention.

19.o: Desperate to rescue Edmee, Arlo and his friends travel to the swamp, where they must battle a formidable foe known as the Bog Lady.
